title: The board block of a RoboHub board manifest
description: What every board of the ecosystem says about itself. A board whose manifest does not match this is a board that does not exist: the toolchain reads the board through this, and a board it cannot read is a board nobody is told about.

connectors.description: The headers a board is known by. A connector is named, and what it carries is said of it.

programmer.description: How the board is programmed. What it is, and what is said of it.

peripherals.description: The peripherals the board brings out. A list, because a board has a number of them.

pins.description: The pin map. A map, because a pin is named and what it is carries.
